meta.name: fable-advisor
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks for a "Fable second opinion", wants to "check a plan before committing", needs another view after repeated failures, or explicitly invokes "fable-advisor".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取第二意见，检查计划可行性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在做重要决定前想听听不同角度的建议
copy.tagline_en: Get a second opinion and check plan feasibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a different perspective before making an important decision

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会调用独立的 Fable 5 模型来审查你的决策或计划，并直接返回 Fable 的原始意见，不修改。
howto.when: 当你要求“Fable 第二意见”、在承诺前检查计划、或多次失败后需要新视角时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Fable 检查一下这个计划是否可行。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Fable 5 给出独立意见。

say.text: 给我一个 Fable 第二意见，关于这个决策。
say.note: Fable 会基于你提供的上下文给出评估。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will invoke the independent Fable 5 model to review your decision or plan, and return Fable's raw opinion without modification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a "Fable second opinion", want to check a plan before committing, or need another view after repeated failures.

say_en.text: Check this plan with Fable for feasibility.
say_en.note: Claude will call Fable 5 for an independent opinion.

say_en.text: Give me a Fable second opinion on this decision.
say_en.note: Fable will evaluate based on the context you provide.
